messages.author: 8c3e0c4226a5e3e2
messages.subject: Stan/RStan Meetup in Las Vegas
parts:
As per Bob Carpenters' request, I would like to announce a meetup on Probabilistic Machine Learning with Stan at the Las Vegas R & Data Science groups (on 23rd, March). Materials (slides, code, & video) will be made available after the meetup. Here are the links to the scheduled meetups.
  1. https://www.meetup.com/Las-Vegas-R-Users-Group/events/237505653/
  2. https://www.meetup.com/Data-Science-Las-Vegas/events/237505738/
Thanks,
-- Daniel
